title: PAWSPACE_PAYMENT_ENV unset or empty falls back to 'sandbox', so verify-first is off and a client-declared 'captured' payment is persisted as financial truth
actor: An ordinary authenticated CUSTOMER. Real platform session cookie minted by tests/helpers/grooming-journey-harness.mjs sessionCookie(db,'customer','CUS-F13','customer:CUS-F13') over a verified identity_binding; resolveActor() returns roleCode='customer' with the default customer permission set (NOT payments.manage, NOT bookings.manage). Non-preview: origin https://uat.pawspace.in, so isDevelopmentPreview() is false and no staff/founder header is used. No staff actor is required at any point.
request: POST /api/canonical-bookings (real exported POST from app/api/canonical-bookings/route.ts) after a real POST /api/uat-scheduling assignment. Body: {idempotencyKey:'SG-F13',scheduleGroupId:'SG-F13',customer:{id:'CUS-F13',name:'F13 Customer',primaryPhone:'+919000000013'},pets:[{sourceId:'p1',name:'Rex',species:'dog',breed:'Indie',vaccinationStatus:'vaccinated'}],cityId:'maa',zoneId:'chennai-core',serviceCode:'grooming',packageCode:'dog-basic',packageName:'Dog basic',scheduledStart:'2026-11-04T09:00:00.000Z',scheduledEnd:'2026-11-04T11:00:00.000Z',provider:<assigned>,totalAmount:1899,amountDueNow:1899,payment:{method:'upi',mode:'prepaid',status:'captured',detail:'client says paid'},pricing:{discount:0}}. Identical body replayed under five Worker env shapes: {} (key ABSENT), {PAWSPACE_PAYMENT_ENV:''}, 'sandbox', 'live', 'production'.
response: 201 in all five cases. The environment shape alone changes what is persisted.
d1_before: canonical_bookings: 0 rows; booking_payments: 0 rows; payment_gateway_events: 0 rows (fresh in-memory D1 per variant).
d1_after: env ABSENT -> booking_payments {method:'upi',mode:'prepaid',status:'captured',amount:1899}; env '' -> status:'captured', amount 1899; env 'sandbox' -> status:'captured', amount 1899; env 'live' -> status:'created', amount 1899; env 'production' -> status:'created', amount 1899. In every 'captured' case payment_gateway_events is EMPTY - no Razorpay order, no signature-verified webhook, nothing but the client's own JSON. canonical_bookings.status='confirmed', total_amount=1899 in all five.
canonical_failure: paymentEnv() reads String(env.PAWSPACE_PAYMENT_ENV||'sandbox'), so an ABSENT or EMPTY variable resolves to 'sandbox', liveMode is false, recordedPaymentStatus() returns the client's own 'captured' verbatim, and booking_payments records Rs 1,899 as collected on a customer's unauthenticated-by-any-gateway assertion - the money control fails OPEN on a missing config value.
refutation: PARTIAL REFUTATION of the deployment claim: the fallback behaviour is exactly as claimed and is reproduced by execution, but 'unset in a real deployment' is NOT demonstrable from this repository. There is no root wrangler.toml/wrangler.jsonc; the only two deploy paths that exist (.github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml via scripts/stage-config.mjs, and .github/workflows/deploy-release-preview.yml via scripts/release-preview-config.mjs) both write PAWSPACE_PAYMENT_ENV:'sandbox' explicitly into the generated dist/server/wrangler.json, and tests/staging-certification.test.mjs already fails certification when the deployed config reports the var as '' or 'live'. So today this is CONFIGURATION-DEPENDENT, not a live exposure: no shipped deploy path leaves it unset. The exposure is latent and asymmetric - the repo contains NO production deploy configuration at all, so the first production Worker stood up outside these two scripts inherits the unset value, and the fallback silently chooses the permissive branch instead of refusing to start.
blast_radius: Per booking, the full prepaid amount: Rs 1,899 on the probe's dog-basic grooming booking, and up to the catalogue maximum on any other service, recorded as collected revenue with zero rupees actually received. Any authenticated customer can do it for their own bookings, unlimited times, with no staff involvement; the business loses the full booking value each time and Finance's booking_payments ledger overstates cash by the same amount. Downstream, a 'captured' payment is what unlocks provider dispatch and post-service settlement, so the provider is also dispatched against an uncollected booking.

title: A Grooming customer can self-cancel a booking that is in_service and receive a 100% refund case while the groomer is mid-appointment
actor: The booking's own CUSTOMER, authenticated with a real platform session cookie (customer:CUS-F24) issued by issuePlatformSession over a verified identity_binding. roleCode='customer', default customer permissions - which include scheduling.book, the only permission /api/grooming-booking-change requires. No staff actor, no payments.manage, no preview bypass (origin https://uat.pawspace.in, isDevelopmentPreview false). The provider is a separate authenticated actor and is not consulted.
request: Full real journey first: POST /api/uat-scheduling -> POST /api/canonical-bookings (Rs 1,899 dog-basic, maa/chennai-core) -> POST /api/grooming-payment-sandbox link_order + payment.captured -> provider session posts POST /api/grooming-lifecycle accept, on_the_way, arrived, start_service (all 200). Then, with the groomer mid-appointment, the CUSTOMER posts POST /api/grooming-booking-change {bookingId,customerId:'CUS-F24',action:'cancel',reason:'changed my mind mid-groom'} with the customer cookie. Run in two shapes: scheduled_start still in the future, and scheduled_start backdated 30 minutes so the appointment window has genuinely begun (minutesUntilStart -31).
response: 200 OK. Body: {data:{status:'cancelled',paymentStatus:'refund_pending',refundCaseId:'<uuid>',refundAmount:1899,policy:{policyVersion:'maa:all:grooming-default:v1',enforcementMode:'enforce',allowed:true,minutesUntilStart:-31,refundPercent:100,feeAmount:0,reasons:['Cancellation is inside the configured cutoff']},capacityReleased:true}}. Identical (refundAmount 1899, refundPercent 100) in the future-window shape, reasons ['Cancellation is before the configured cutoff'].
d1_before: canonical_bookings {status:'in_service',total_amount:1899}; provider_work_orders {status:'in_service'}; booking_payments {status:'captured',amount:1899}; booking_refund_cases table did not yet exist (zero refund cases).
d1_after: canonical_bookings {status:'cancelled'}; provider_work_orders {status:'cancelled'} - the in-flight job is terminated under the groomer; booking_payments {status:'refund_pending',amount:1899}; booking_refund_cases {booking_id:<id>,amount:1899,reason:'changed my mind mid-groom',status:'requested',requested_by:'customer:CUS-F24'}. Also scheduling_reservations and scheduling_assignment_decisions set to 'cancelled'.
canonical_failure: evaluateBookingChange() gates cancellation only on policy.changeLockStatuses, which is ['completed','cancelled'] in both the founder-seeded default and the city policy, so 'in_service' is not locked; the cancel branch then picks refundPercentAfterCutoff (100) and /api/grooming-booking-change files a Rs 1,899 100%-refund case and cancels the provider's live work order, on a customer-only session, while the service is being performed.
blast_radius: Rs 1,899 per booking on the probe's dog-basic package - the entire captured amount refunded after the service has been at least partly delivered; the groomer's travel and in-progress labour are unpaid and the work order is force-cancelled mid-job. This is the CHEAPEST case: the same path applies to every Grooming package and multi-pet booking, so the exposure is 100% of any Grooming booking value that reaches in_service. Both policy shapes give 100%: with enforcement_mode='enforce' the seeded refund_percent_after_cutoff is 100, and with the founder default enforcement_mode='observe' evaluateBookingChange explicitly overwrites refundPercent to 100 for any non-locked status. Requires only the booking's own authenticated customer - no staff, no approval, unlimited repeats across bookings.

title: Stay balance idempotency key is globally unique instead of per booking, so reusing one key across two bookings settles the second with no capture event recorded
risk_category: payment ledger / revenue misstatement (silent loss of a settlement event)
actor: An ordinary authenticated CUSTOMER (real platform session cookie, roleCode='customer', permission scheduling.book only - the exact permission /api/stay-balance POST requires). Reproduced in two shapes: (a) one customer settling two of their OWN stays, (b) two DIFFERENT customers (customer:CUS-ALICE and customer:CUS-BOB) each settling their own stay with the same client-supplied key. requireCustomerOwnership passes in both - no privilege is needed and no cross-tenant access is involved; the collision is in the storage key, not in authorization. Origin https://uat.pawspace.in, no preview bypass, no staff actor.
request: Two real stay_payment_schedules created with the real exported staySplitScheduleStatement(): BK-STAY-A (total 10000, balance 5000) and BK-STAY-B (total 24000, balance 12000). Then POST /api/stay-balance {action:'pay_balance',bookingId:'BK-STAY-A',idempotencyKey:'customer-retry-key-1'} followed by POST /api/stay-balance {action:'pay_balance',bookingId:'BK-STAY-B',idempotencyKey:'customer-retry-key-1'} - the SAME key, a DIFFERENT booking. Cross-customer variant: BK-ALICE (balance 4000, Alice's cookie) then BK-BOB (pet_sitting, balance 15000, Bob's cookie), both with idempotencyKey 'pay-balance'.
response: Both calls return 201 with duplicatePrevented:false. Second call body: {bookingId:'BK-STAY-B',balanceAmount:12000,status:'paid',paymentRef:'SBX-BAL-17458DF2-4',duplicatePrevented:false}. Cross-customer: Bob gets 201, status 'paid', paymentRef 'SBX-BAL-D0F05054-E', balanceAmount 15000, duplicatePrevented false. Nothing in either response says an event was dropped.
d1_before: stay_payment_schedules: BK-STAY-A {balance 5000,status 'pending_balance',payment_ref NULL}, BK-STAY-B {balance 12000,status 'pending_balance',payment_ref NULL}. stay_payment_events: EMPTY.
d1_after: stay_payment_schedules: BOTH rows status='paid' with distinct payment_refs. stay_payment_events contains EXACTLY ONE row - {booking_id:'BK-STAY-A',event_type:'balance_captured',idempotency_key:'customer-retry-key-1'}. There is NO balance_captured row for BK-STAY-B at all. Cross-customer variant identical: only BK-ALICE has an event; BK-BOB's Rs 15,000 settlement has none. security_audit_events DOES carry a stay_balance.pay row for both bookings (amount 5000 and amount 12000), so the loss is confined to the payments-domain event ledger, which is what reconciliation reads.
canonical_failure: ensureStayPaymentTables declares stay_payment_events.idempotency_key as TEXT UNIQUE (global) rather than UNIQUE(booking_id,idempotency_key), and payStayBalance flips the schedule to 'paid' BEFORE inserting the event and then swallows any /UNIQUE/i error as a benign replay - so a second booking reusing the same key is marked settled for its full balance (Rs 12,000, and Rs 15,000 in the cross-customer run) while its balance_captured event is silently discarded and duplicatePrevented still reports false.
blast_radius: Per collision, the entire balance leg of one stay disappears from the capture ledger: Rs 12,000 on the 24,000 boarding stay and Rs 15,000 on the 30,000 sitting stay in the runs above; on a 50/50 split that is always 50% of the stay value, unbounded by package. Idempotency keys are client-supplied and the route accepts any non-empty string, so a client app that hard-codes a key ('pay-balance'), or two customers who both retry with '1', collide by accident rather than by attack - the first stay in the whole database to use a given string permanently poisons it for every other booking. Finance reconciles stays from stay_payment_events, so those balances read as never captured while the schedule reads as paid; the two ledgers disagree by the full balance amount. Compounding observation (outside this finding): payStayBalance has no PAWSPACE_PAYMENT_ENV guard at all in current HEAD - it mints an SBX-BAL-* ref and sets status='paid' in every environment, so in LIVE the same call settles the balance leg with no Razorpay order behind it.

title: A confirmed Sitting/Boarding booking stores a price decomposition that does not add up to the amount charged
actor: An ordinary authenticated CUSTOMER (real platform session cookie, roleCode='customer'), origin https://uat.pawspace.in, no preview bypass, no staff actor. Same actor for the quote, the sandbox capture and the booking.
request: Full governed Sitting path, real routes only: (1) POST /api/sitting-commercial {packageCode:'sitting-overnight',petCount:N,cityId:'maa',zoneId:'chennai-core',scheduledStart:'2026-11-26T09:00:00.000Z',scheduledEnd:'2026-11-28T09:00:00.000Z',paymentMode:'prepaid'|'split_50_50'}; (2) POST /api/sitting-payment-sandbox {quoteId,amount:<quote.amountDueNow>} with header x-payment-capture-key; (3) POST /api/uat-scheduling for serviceCode 'pet_sitting' with preferredProviderId (host-selected services refuse auto-assignment); (4) POST /api/sitting-bookings with the quote id and the server's own totalAmount/amountDueNow. Run for N=1,2,3 prepaid and N=1,2,3 split_50_50, each at least twice. Two tampering runs additionally submitted totalAmount=100 and totalAmount=99999 against a correct capture. NOTE: /api/canonical-bookings does refuse serviceCode 'pet_sitting' with 409 'A Pet Sitting booking must be confirmed through the governed Sitting route with a server Sitting quote', as PTJA-P0-02 states.
response: Quote 201, capture 201, booking 201 on every honest run. Both tampering runs: 409 {'error':'Sitting amount does not match the server quote'} - no booking, no payment row, quote left open.
d1_before: canonical_bookings, booking_payments, stay_payment_schedules empty; sitting_commercial_quotes holds the open server quote with total_amount and amount_due_now.
d1_after: Every run reconciles exactly. N=2 prepaid: canonical_bookings.total_amount=2396, booking_payments {amount:2396, amount_due_now:2396, status:'captured'}, pricing_json {billableUnits:2,basePricePerPet:799,extraPetPrice:399,catalogueVersion:'sitting-v1',mode:'overnight',sittingQuoteId,paymentReference,liveMoney:false}; (799 + 399*(2-1)) * 2 = 2396 = total_amount = payment amount = quote total. N=1: 1598 (799*2). N=3: 3194 ((799+399*2)*2). Split N=2: total_amount 2396, booking_payments.amount 2396, amount_due_now 1198, stay_payment_schedules {total_amount:2396,paid_now_amount:1198,balance_amount:1198,status:'pending_balance'} - 1198+1198=2396. Split N=3: 1597+1597=3194. No run produced a mismatch.
refutation: REFUTED. Across 8 successful governed Sitting bookings (petCount 1/2/3, prepaid and split_50_50, each shape run twice) the decomposition persisted in canonical_bookings.pricing_json reconstructs the charged amount exactly: (basePricePerPet + extraPetPrice*(petCount-1)) * billableUnits == canonical_bookings.total_amount == booking_payments.amount == the server quote's totalAmount, and for split_50_50 booking_payments.amount_due_now + stay_payment_schedules.balance_amount == total_amount. governSittingBooking re-derives the price from the stored quote and refuses any client-submitted total that differs (409 'Sitting amount does not match the server quote'), so the client cannot force a decomposition/total divergence either. One genuine but non-financial weakness observed: pricing_json omits petCount and omits the total itself, so the decomposition is only reconstructible by joining canonical_bookings.pet_ids_json - a reporting inconvenience, not an arithmetic error, and every value needed is present in the booking row.
blast_radius: None observed. Rupee impact to customer or business: Rs 0 - no run produced a booking whose stored decomposition disagreed with the amount charged, and the two tampering attempts were refused before any row was written.

title: Boarding catalogue GET keeps advertising the old per-pet price after Pricing Control is activated, while the quote POST on the same page charges the new one
risk_category: price-display divergence; revenue misstatement in both directions
actor: NO AUTHENTICATED ACTOR IS REQUIRED. /api/boarding-commercial is on lib/api-gateway.ts's no-permission list (requiredPermission returns null for that pathname), and neither the GET nor the POST handler calls resolveActor. The probe sent no session cookie, no forwarded-identity header and no staff credential; both calls succeeded. Any anonymous visitor to the Boarding page sees the stale advertised price and gets the different quote.
request: GET /api/boarding-commercial?cityId=blr&zoneId=blr-east&scheduledStart=2026-11-26T09:00:00.000Z (reads data.packages[boarding-24h].base_price_per_pet), then POST /api/boarding-commercial {packageCode:'boarding-24h',petCount:2,cityId:'blr',zoneId:'blr-east',scheduledStart:'2026-11-26T09:00:00.000Z',scheduledEnd:'2026-11-28T09:00:00.000Z',paymentMode:'prepaid'} (reads data.basePricePerPet and data.totalAmount) - the same pair the Boarding page itself makes. Sampled five states: (A) Pricing Control not activated; (B) service_packages row for boarding-24h set active=1, base_price=1500, effective_from 2026-08-01, effective_to NULL; (C) same but effective_from 2027-01-01; (D) same but effective_to 2026-09-01; (E) same window as B but base_price lowered to 400.
response: GET 200 and POST 201 in every state. (A) GET 699 / POST 699, total 2796. (B) GET 699 / POST 1500, total 6000. (C) GET 699 / POST 699, total 2796. (D) GET 699 / POST 699, total 2796. (E) GET 699 / POST 400, total 1600.
d1_before: service_packages boarding-24h {base_price:699, active:0, effective_from:'2026-08-01', effective_to:NULL} - self-provisioned inactive at the catalogue price. boarding_commercial_packages boarding-24h {base_price_per_pet:699, active:1, effective_from:'2026-08-01', effective_to:NULL}. The two agree, and so do GET and POST.
d1_after: Only service_packages changes when an operator activates Pricing Control; boarding_commercial_packages.base_price_per_pet stays 699 forever because nothing writes it. In state B the operator-controlled row reads base_price 1500 while the catalogue row still reads 699, and the two endpoints report those two numbers respectively. Quote rows written to boarding_commercial_quotes carry total_amount 6000 - the charged number, not the advertised one.
canonical_failure: GET /api/boarding-commercial serves listBoardingPackages(), which reads base_price_per_pet from boarding_commercial_packages, while POST on the same route serves createLiveBoardingQuote(), which overrides that price with resolveLivePrice() reading service_packages - so once an operator activates a Pricing Control row the page advertises Rs 699 per pet per night and the quote on the same page charges Rs 1,500, a 2-pet 2-night stay quoting Rs 6,000 against an advertised Rs 2,796.
refutation: NOT refuted by PTJA-P0-01. The effective_from/effective_to window that fix added to lib/live-pricing-resolver.ts only restores agreement in the cases where the Pricing Control price does NOT apply: with effective_from 2027-01-01 (state C) or effective_to 2026-09-01 (state D) the resolver falls back to the catalogue price and GET and POST agree at 699. In the normal case the operator actually intends - an active row whose window covers the stay (state B) - the divergence is unchanged and fully reproduced on current HEAD. The fix narrowed WHEN Pricing Control applies; it did not make the catalogue endpoint read the same source.
blast_radius: On the probe's 2-pet, 2-night boarding-24h stay: the customer is quoted Rs 6,000 having been shown Rs 699 per pet per night, i.e. Rs 3,204 more than the advertised page implies (Rs 2,796) - a 115% overshoot, presented to an anonymous, unauthenticated visitor with no staff involvement. It scales linearly with pets and nights, so a 3-pet 7-night stay diverges by Rs 16,821 on the same two rows. The exposure runs BOTH ways and both are real money: state E shows an operator LOWERING the Pricing Control price to Rs 400 while the page still advertises Rs 699, so the business collects Rs 1,600 on a stay it is advertising at Rs 2,796 - Rs 1,196 of revenue silently forgone per stay. Because the catalogue row is never written by Pricing Control, the divergence is permanent from the moment of activation rather than a cache-staleness window.
